protocol: Same heldout QA, no note vs full correct note vs matched wrong note. No finetuning.
warning: Correct clinical record can reveal the reference answer. This is a context-reading oracle, NOT evidence of patient memorization.
Some case summaries may not explicitly support the target answer; review patient notes before interpreting errors.
Heldout QA have been used in earlier diagnostics and are exploratory.
Wrong-record controls are matched within candidate pairs; factually related wrong cases may share medical language.
